steps: Open the authenticated integrated root app.
Expand Ressourcer in the common navigation.
Verify Overblik, Enheder, Ejendomme, Medarbejdere, Units, Varekatalog, Lagerlokationer and Certifikater.
Verify only Generelt, Ressourcer, Priser, Brugere & roller and Godkendelsesregler are visible.
Verify old Enheder, FLEET-kategorier, Medarbejdere, Kasseliste, Standardpriser, Kundepriser and PROCURE approval entries are not duplicated.
Select the free OBD device and confirm save.
Reload and verify the OBD device remains selected.
Open NB-001 and verify the attached OBD is absent from selectable options.
Call the authenticated emulator function for NB-001 and verify ALREADY_EXISTS.
Register GPS hardware in the authenticated setup UI.
Attach it to a clearly marked synthetic unit through the authenticated local function.
Reload setup and verify the registered attachment.
Attempt attachment to REVIEW-UNIT-SECONDARY and verify ALREADY_EXISTS.

limitations: No external OBD or GPS service was called or enabled.
All browser data in this report is synthetic emulator data.
The browser run covers the authenticated administrator path; route/rules tests cover permission denial and tenant isolation.
